rows.desktop_responsibility: Owns the trusted noVNC post-connect liveness beacon and detector inputs: impactful keyboard/pointer activity versus framebuffer/socket output, with bounded single-episode stall reporting.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: The product can distinguish an apparently connected VNC session that is accepting user input but producing no remote output, without treating ordinary quiet periods as failures.
rows.ios_platform_delta: WKUserScript instruments the same noVNC rfb/display/websock internals and sends counters to the sole native RemoteComputerWebView owner. IOSVNCLivenessDetector preserves the 10-second impactful-input/no-output semantics natively.
rows.test_evidence: mobile/ios/FabushiTests/PreloadParityTests.swift covers detector behavior, bridge message parsing and required noVNC instrumentation. Fresh exact-HEAD CI required before verified.
rows.notes: Audited against Desktop final HEAD 798cf51d. No separate polling owner is introduced; the WebView bridge owns collection and the existing native detector owns classification.

rows.desktop_responsibility: Owns trusted VNC viewer visibility transition state used to rebaseline viewer-side behavior when a hidden Computer surface becomes visible again.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: Revealing the Computer viewer re-establishes current viewer state without treating repeated visible notifications as new transitions.
rows.ios_platform_delta: Native UIViewRepresentable lifecycle feeds visibility into IOSVNCViewerVisibilityGate; hidden-to-visible transitions reset liveness in the same single VNC runtime.
rows.test_evidence: mobile/ios/FabushiTests/PreloadParityTests.swift verifies transition-only signaling and liveness rebaseline.

rows.desktop_responsibility: Composes the trusted noVNC preload responsibilities, including RFB session observation, liveness, viewer visibility and other VNC-scoped trusted behavior, and installs them only on the VNC viewer boundary.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: The Computer shell receives actual RFB connection/reconnection/disconnection and liveness signals from the trusted viewer rather than guessing transport state from page navigation.
rows.ios_platform_delta: WKWebView replaces Electron preload/IPC. RemoteComputerWebView installs one main-frame-only WKUserScript and one private WKScriptMessageHandler; the script observes noVNC root state and trusted counters/cursor events, while IOSVNCPreloadRuntime owns session tracking and liveness. didFinish remains viewer-ready only.
